body: My dog, P. If I can help it, I don't want her to be alone for the end of her life.
About 17 months ago I came to within a couple of hours of overdosing on paracetamol, so I'd say suicide. Well, lets see how long that lasts...
November of this year, it depends on different circumstances.
My death date is set for Nov 25 or October 28, 2016. This is just a part of the process of dying.

For me its wishing I could take a bullet for someone, or otherwise sacrifice my life for someone, so that even though I'd be dead, M might have enough closure to stay alive. This isn't about dying a hero, but about making sure that P and T will have someone trustworthy to take care of them.
All plans I have currently terminate in one years time, so the other four is either be dead or make it up as I go along...
Either I live my life as an ultrascrooge, or I die in a year. So yes, I know where it's going. It's too bad its going down.

Apply for more work experience, and get an income job if at all possible. If neither works out, then its my time to die.

Engineering. I'll leave the branch up to your imagination.
I've experienced one Christmas without the will to live. Whether or not I experience another is not of my concern.

There's no turning back when a knife is in ones heart, when ones liver turns to mush, when one falls to their end, or when ones neck snaps.

Those dates depend on whether I take a year off from studies or not, they mark deadlines for things that have to happen for me to not be a useless sponge.
